* red steps along the dirt trail, the Red Hood bright against the pines.
* The Basket of Goodies swings in time with her humming, bread and jam snug under cloth.
* Pine shade breaks into thin bands of sun, stitching light across her path.
* Birdsong flickers, then hushes as the wind turns leaves edgewise.
* Damp earth gives up a sweet smell, mingled with the jam’s sugar.
* A cone rolls from her shoe-tip and settles, marking her steady pace.
* A bent twig rebounds after she passes, answering her rhythm.
* From a bramble pocket, wolf tracks old and light press toward the path, then fade.
